approved_classes.ex:AminoAcid: Amino acids are the building blocks of proteins.
approved_classes.ex:Protein: Proteins are made up of amino acids.
approved_classes.ex:ChemicalSubstance: Amino acids are a class of chemicals.
approved_classes.ex:EssentialAminoAcid: Amino acids that are not produced by the body and must be obtained through food.
approved_classes.ex:NonEssentialAminoAcid: Amino acids that are produced by the body and do not require supplementation.
approved_classes.ex:SemiEssentialAminoAcid: Amino acids that are produced in the body but in insufficient amounts.
approved_classes.ex:Acid: Amino acids can undergo reactions with alkalies to form salts.
approved_classes.ex:Base: Amino acids can undergo reactions with acids to form salts.
approved_classes.ex:Zwitterion: Amino acids can exist as zwitterions due to the presence of both positive and negative charges.
approved_classes.ex:Ninhydrin: A chemical used in reactions with amino acids to detect their presence.
approved_classes.ex:AliphaticAminoAcid: Amino acids with aliphatic side chains.
approved_classes.ex:BetaAminoAcid: Amino acids with the amino group attached to the third carbon of the carboxyl group.
approved_classes.ex:GammaAminoAcid: Amino acids with the amino group attached to the fourth carbon of the carboxyl group.
approved_classes.ex:IminoAminoAcid: Amino acids with an imino group instead of an amino group.
approved_classes.ex:KetogenicAminoAcid: Amino acids that can be used to make fat and are transformed into ketone bodies.
approved_classes.ex:KetogenicAndGlucogenicAminoAcid: Amino acids that can be metabolized into both ketogenic and glucogenic pathways.
approved_classes.ex:PurelyGlucogenicAminoAcid: Amino acids that can be used as a starting point for the production of glucose or glycogen.
approved_classes.ex:NonPolarAminoAcid: Amino acids with no charge on the 'R' group.
approved_classes.ex:PolarAminoAcidWithNoCharge: Amino acids with an uncharged 'R' group but with groups that contribute to hydrogen bonding.
approved_classes.ex:PolarAminoAcidWithPositiveCharge: Amino acids with a positive charge on the 'R' group.
approved_classes.ex:PolarAminoAcidWithNegativeCharge: Amino acids with a negative charge on the 'R' group.
approved_classes.ex:SulphurContainingAminoAcid: Amino acids with a sulfohydryl or thioether group.
approved_classes.ex:Hydroxyproline: Hydroxyproline is required for the formation of collagen, the body's principal structural protein.
approved_classes.ex:BetaHydroxyGlutamicAcid: Used to treat acne, photoaging, dry skin, psoriasis, and melasma, among other dermatological diseases.
approved_classes.ex:DPenicillamine: Used in the chelation therapy of Wilson’s disease.
approved_classes.ex:NAcetylcysteine: Used in cystic fibrosis, and chronic renal insufficiency, as it can function as an antioxidant.

ex:hasComposition.comment: Amino acids are a component of chemical substances.

ex:isEssential.comment: Indicates whether an amino acid is essential or not.

ex:isNonEssential.comment: Indicates whether an amino acid is non-essential or not.

ex:isSemiEssential.comment: Indicates whether an amino acid is semi-essential or not.

ex:hasFunction.comment: Amino acids have functions in the synthesis of proteins.

ex:reactsWith.comment: Chemical substances can react with each other.

ex:reactsWithNinhydrin.comment: Amino acids can react with ninhydrin to form a color.

ex:hasAliphaticSideChain.comment: Indicates whether an amino acid has an aliphatic side chain.

ex:hasBetaPosition.comment: Indicates whether an amino acid has the amino group attached to the third carbon of the carboxyl group.

ex:hasGammaPosition.comment: Indicates whether an amino acid has the amino group attached to the fourth carbon of the carboxyl group.

ex:hasHydroxylGroup.comment: Indicates whether an amino acid has a hydroxyl group.

ex:hasIminoGroup.comment: Indicates whether an amino acid has an imino group.

ex:hasHeterocyclicStructure.comment: Indicates whether an amino acid has a heterocyclic structure.

ex:isKetogenic.comment: Indicates whether an amino acid is ketogenic.

ex:isKetogenicAndGlucogenic.comment: Indicates whether an amino acid is ketogenic and glucogenic.

ex:isPurelyGlucogenic.comment: Indicates whether an amino acid is purely glucogenic.

ex:isNonPolar.comment: Indicates whether an amino acid is non-polar.

ex:isPolarWithNoCharge.comment: Indicates whether an amino acid is polar with no charge on the 'R' group.

ex:isPolarWithPositiveCharge.comment: Indicates whether an amino acid is polar with a positive charge on the 'R' group.

ex:isPolarWithNegativeCharge.comment: Indicates whether an amino acid is polar with a negative charge on the 'R' group.

ex:isSulphurContaining.comment: Indicates whether an amino acid is sulphur containing.

ex:isHydroxyproline.comment: Indicates whether an amino acid is hydroxyproline.

ex:isBetaHydroxyGlutamicAcid.comment: Indicates whether an amino acid is beta-hydroxy glutamic acid.

ex:isDPenicillamine.comment: Indicates whether an amino acid is D-penicillamine.

ex:isNAcetylcysteine.comment: Indicates whether an amino acid is N-acetylcysteine.

ex:isGabapentin.comment: Indicates whether an amino acid is gabapentin.
